change: The main RGB capture call supplies an after_resume callback only when mission_stepper exists, hence only on the selected local45 PhysX mission path. Startup/default RTX/canonical paths receive None.

The existing capture policy invokes this optional callback only after successful pause_resume capture and timeline.play. Failed capture and preserve_playing policy do not flush. Captured media data/schema are unchanged.

_flush_local45_capture_resume calls world.render once, compares exact before/after actual World frame/time and copied robot poses, and requires native world.is_playing() after the flush. No tolerance, step retry, app.update fallback or state write.

A latest atomic capture-resume-state.json records run_id/capture_index, before/after frame/time/playing, physics_match, pose_match/per-robot matches, render_attempted and error. Readbacks are attempted even if render raises; the original error is preserved if later readback/checkpoint also fails.
The stepper's stored state and one-step guard remain unchanged. Render-only state changes or a still-paused World fail rather than continuing silently.

root_api.helper: _flush_local45_capture_resume(world, robots, *, output, run_id, capture_index) -> diagnostic dict; raises on failed render/freeze/playing checks
root_api.checkpoint: <output>/capture-resume-state.json; latest capture only, no per-frame journal or pose bulk data

validation.scope: Queued play committed by one render, exact frozen state and next genuine step; frame/time change including1e-10s; in-place pose change; paused/raising render; checkpoint failure preserving primary error; default/preserve-playing/failed-capture paths without extra flush. Main caller placement was read, not asserted by source-string tests.
Parse affected source/test bytes and emit SHA256; no product or SDK import.
